decisions.reason: Because this service remained visible on its own page in both 2023 and 2024, it likely met or exceeded the firm's aspiration level well enough to justify continuation, and a German consultancy would usually retain a proven, low-fixed-cost service offering unless performance clearly deteriorates.

As a 2024 launch still in its early evaluation phase, the workshops likely face more uncertainty relative to aspiration levels, but the firm would typically keep testing a closely related, resource-light service for another period before reallocating resources unless results are clearly disappointing.
